summary: SCHMID Group N.V. filed a Form 6-K reporting share issuances to offset EUR 30.75 million in financial liabilities with related parties, conversions of USD 12 million of convertible notes into shares, compliance with Nasdaq listing rules, and a proposed new share incentive plan. These are routine capital management and compliance updates, not an acquisition, divestiture, or other special-situation event. The filing includes no change of control, tender, or strategic review. No special-situation category applies. What to watch: shareholder approval of the share issuances on May 20, 2026, and the timing of the delayed 2025 Form 20-F filing.
